title: MedSAM2
description: Interactive 3D segmentation of MRI and CT scans from point and box prompts with MedSAM2 (SAM 2.1 Hiera-Tiny).

segment.title: Segment 3D volume from prompts
segment.description: Segment one or more 3D objects from slice point/box prompts using MedSAM2's image encoder, prompt decoder and bidirectional 3D memory propagation.

image.description: One 3D NIfTI volume or DICOM series

prompts.description: JSON array in canonical RAS slice coordinates (axial col L->R / row A->P, coronal col L->R / row S->I, sagittal col P->A / row S->I), one entry per object: {"axis"?: "axial"|"coronal"|"sagittal", "slice": int, "points"?: [[x, y, 1|0], ...], "box"?: [x0, y0, x1, y1], "propagate"?: true, "range"?: [minSlice, maxSlice]}

window.description: Intensity window preset (auto uses 0.5-99.5% percentile for MRI)

stopOnEmpty.description: Stop propagation along a direction when two consecutive slices have no foreground

backend.description: Inference backend; auto prefers hardware WebGPU and falls back to WebAssembly
